en.description:
HORSE is a wrist-first basketball game built for real courts.

Leave your phone on the sideline. Your Apple Watch calls the next shot, then you record the result with one tap or a quick swipe. Misses add letters. Keep making shots to stay alive.

BUILT FOR APPLE WATCH

• Tap the checkmark when you make the shot
• Tap the X when you miss
• Swipe right to call a different shot
• Swipe left to undo the last result
• Turn the Digital Crown to skip to a new shot
• Pause and resume without losing your run

PLAY YOUR WAY

Choose from four shot packs:

• Close: layups, free throws, and short shots
• Normal: a balanced mix that gets harder as you play
• Tricks: banks, fades, deep shots, and unusual calls
• Kids: simple calls for younger players

Outdoor mode makes the make and miss controls larger for quick taps on the court.

MADE FOR THE GAME

HORSE keeps your best score on your watch and adds a clear final-letter warning before the game is on the line. Haptics confirm makes, misses, clutch shots, resets, and game over.

Launch a new run from the app, Smart Stack, watch face, or Control Center.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account. No ads. No analytics. No tracking. Your score and preferences stay on your Apple Watch.
en.releaseNotes: Meet HORSE's bold new app icon, designed to stand out on Apple Watch. This update also refines the Home, Controls, and gameplay layouts with cleaner alignment and spacing.
en.subtitle: Basketball on your wrist
